seq_after_fullstop_skip.title: Sit out the trade after a full-size stop-out
seq_after_fullstop_skip.verdict: 2026 +$20,513 PF 4.5 (1.92/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$14,286 PF 1.28 (2.78/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Not better in both periods. Loses money in 2021-25 and drops 2026 under 2 setups a week. The trade after a full-size stop-out is a normal-to-good trade (+0.14R avg vs +0.06R overall).

seq_after_fullstop_half.title: Half size after a full-size stop-out
seq_after_fullstop_half.verdict: 2026 +$20,264 PF 4.13 (2.16/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$15,432 PF 1.27 (3.17/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Not better in both periods. Less money in both periods: the trade after a full-size stop-out is not worse than average.

seq_after_big500_skip.title: Sit out the trade after a $500+ loss
seq_after_big500_skip.verdict: 2026 +$20,490 PF 3.94 (2.14/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$16,990 PF 1.3 (3.06/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Better in both periods on paper. Too thin to judge: 26 cases in 2021-25 (+$611 from an average of -$22 a trade), 1 case in 2026 (a -$3 scratch). Not adopted.

seq_after_big500_half.title: Half size after a $500+ loss
seq_after_big500_half.verdict: 2026 +$20,489 PF 3.94 (2.16/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$16,729 PF 1.28 (3.17/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Better in both periods on paper. Too thin to judge: 26 cases in 2021-25, 1 in 2026; +$350 over 5 years is noise. Not adopted.

seq_after_big300_half.title: Half size after a $300+ loss
seq_after_big300_half.verdict: 2026 +$20,674 PF 4.05 (2.16/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$17,718 PF 1.31 (3.17/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Better in both periods on paper. Better in both periods on paper (+$187 / +$1,339) but a lucky threshold: half size after a $250+ or a $400+ loss LOSES money in 2021-25 (-$668 / -$1,461), and 2026 has 4 cases.

seq_after_stop_half.title: Half size after any full stop-out
seq_after_stop_half.verdict: 2026 +$16,336 PF 3.52 (2.16/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$16,155 PF 1.3 (3.17/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Not better in both periods. 2026 -$4,151: the trades after a stop-out include many of the big winners.

seq_after_loss_half.title: Half size after any losing trade
seq_after_loss_half.verdict: 2026 +$9,453 PF 2.7 (2.16/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$10,161 PF 1.24 (3.17/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Not better in both periods. Half size on 78% of trades: about half the money in both periods. The next trade after a loss is not worse (dependence test).

seq_after_loss_150.title: 1.5x size after any losing trade (the opposite bet)
seq_after_loss_150.verdict: 2026 +$29,059 PF 4.53 (2.16/wk) vs live +$20,487 PF 3.94; 2021-25 +$21,762 PF 1.29 (3.17/wk) vs live +$16,379 PF 1.27. Better in both periods on paper. More money in both periods, but it is just more size (25% more $ at risk; a uniform 1.25x gets most of it): 2021-25 1-month eval fails 16.5% vs 5.2%, max DD -$11.5k vs -$9.3k.
